description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, and civil, nautical and astronomical dawn and dusk for a town, city or coordinates on a date, in local time.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name to pick among same-named towns.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today in the place's timezone.

place.description: Town or city name, optionally with country: "Riyadh", "Birmingham, UK", "القاهرة". Or use latitude/longitude.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for coordinates, e.g. "Europe/London". Default: from the nearest town.

name: sun_times
title: Sunrise, sunset and twilight times
